entities.summary: I am a Senior Data Analyst at Bridgemark, effective this pay period, with an annual salary of $74,500. I took over the MedVantage quarterly reporting deliverable around March 3rd, which contributed to my promotion. I attended a team offsite near Mount Hood, where colleague Raj Patel presented a dashboard prototype to upper management. I prefer smaller breakout sessions over large group activities. I no longer have a freelance visualization gig, which ended in February, and am currently focused on Bridgemark and the MedVantage work. I have a long-term interest in moving toward data engineering, though no concrete plans yet.

entities.name: one important correction — they restructured titles in february and mine became just data analyst, no junior or senior labels anymore. so if i ever said junior data analyst before, that's outdated now. the whole team got flattened into a single title tier. i want to make sure my records reflect the current title accurately going forward.
